schedules.name: NSE cash equity delivery via Zerodha
schedules.notes: ASSUMED BACKFILL (opt-in; every run using it is flagged and cannot support promotion). Extends the CURRENT rates back to 2020-07-01 (the start of the uniform stamp duty). Evidence per item: STT - cash rates unchanged across NSE circulars 2016, 2023, 2024, 2026 (evidenced); stamp duty - uniform from 2020-07-01 (evidenced); NSE transaction - NOT evidenced for the client side: the exchange's member tariff was slab-based (about 3.00-3.45 per lakh) before Oct 2024 and a client rate may have differed; SEBI fee, GST, Zerodha brokerage and DP charge - no dated history captured. Costs in this period are approximate.

sources.quote: Equity and Futures - ₹0.01 per crore + GST of the traded value.
Charged at ₹10 per crore + GST by Securities and Exchange Board of India
Transfer of Security other than debenture on delivery basis 0.015% Buyer Transfer of Security other than debenture on non-delivery basis 0.003% Buyer
₹15.34 per scrip (₹3.5 CDSL fee + ₹9.5 Zerodha fee + ₹2.34 GST) is charged on the trading account ledger when stocks are sold, irrespective of quantity.
0.1% on buy & sell
The above revision will be applicable with effect from March 1, 2026.
All sale and purchase transactions in securities other than debt securities 0.0001 per cent of the price at which the securities are purchased or sold (Rs.10 per crore)
